svg.title: Coordination activity by day and hour for each actor
svg.desc: Three small-multiple heatmaps, one per actor: rows are days, columns are hours (US Eastern), shade is the number of coordination events.
svg.text: When each actor acts: 7,955 coordination events by day and hour (US Eastern)
Excludes artifact statements and their supersessions. One shared shade scale; a blank cell means no recorded event.
Observed counts. Workroom head 764cf535, 42,878 events, 1 to 16 Oct 2026 UTC.
